evidence.reason: The dependency walker follows the symlink with stat(), but then silently skips any non-regular target at lines 695-696. A symlinked drop-in directory such as backup.service.d is therefore never examined, even though systemd resolves that directory and can read a dependency edge such as Wants=crq-tick.service from it. The scan can then report complete/supported without observing the dependency. Recording an incomplete observation preserves the intentional no-follow policy while fixing the false completeness claim; this is a routine correctness repair, not a new architecture or owner-level behavior change.
